test_name: Verify Pagination for Test Suite List
description: Ensure that users can navigate through multiple pages of test suites using pagination controls.
steps: Navigate to the Test Suites page.
Verify the presence of pagination controls.
Click on the '2' button to navigate to the second page.
Verify that the second page of test suites is displayed.
Click the 'Next' arrow button to go to the next page.
Click the 'Last' button to navigate to the last page.
Verify that the last page of test suites is displayed.
Click the 'First' button to navigate to the first page.
Ensure that the first page of test suites is displayed.
expected_results: Users can navigate between pages seamlessly.
The correct page of test suites is displayed after navigation.
Edge buttons ('First' and 'Last') work as expected.
edge_cases: Navigate to a page with no test suites.
Test pagination with a very large dataset.
Validate behavior when clicking disabled pagination buttons.
Ensure buttons are accessible with keyboard navigation.
Check behavior when rapidly clicking pagination buttons.
data_requirements: Multiple pages of test suites data.
Dataset with varying number of test suites per page.
Test data to validate edge cases (e.g., empty pages).
dependencies: Pagination controls are implemented on the page.
Test suite data is correctly divided across pages.
api_interactions: GET requests to fetch test suites for the specific page.
performance_metrics: Page navigation should complete within 1 second.
Pagination controls should remain responsive during interactions.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure pagination buttons have ARIA roles.
Verify keyboard accessibility for pagination controls.
Pagination should be readable by screen readers.
